description: This file defines an abstract class DataStreamReader in the org.apache.spark.sql.streaming package, providing an interface for reading streaming datasets from external storage systems in Apache Spark. It includes methods for setting data source format, schema, options, and loading various data formats such as JSON, CSV, XML, ORC, Parquet, and text, as well as defining streaming tables.

classes.name: DataStreamReader
classes.description: An abstract class providing an interface to load streaming datasets from external sources in Spark.

methods.name: format
methods.description: Specifies the input data source format.

methods.name: schema
methods.description: Sets the input schema either via StructType or DDL string.

methods.name: option
methods.description: Adds an input option for the data source, overloaded for String, Boolean, Long, Double.

methods.name: options
methods.description: Adds multiple input options from Scala Map or Java Map.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads data stream as DataFrame, either with or without a specified path.

methods.name: json
methods.description: Loads a JSON file stream as DataFrame, with schema validation.

methods.name: csv
methods.description: Loads a CSV file stream as DataFrame.

methods.name: xml
methods.description: Loads an XML file stream as DataFrame, with schema validation.

methods.name: orc
methods.description: Loads an ORC file stream as DataFrame.

methods.name: parquet
methods.description: Loads a Parquet file stream as DataFrame.

methods.name: table
methods.description: Defines a streaming DataFrame on a table.

methods.name: text
methods.description: Loads text files as DataFrame with a 'value' column.

methods.name: textFile
methods.description: Loads text files as Dataset of String, ignoring partitioning info.

methods.name: assertNoSpecifiedSchema
methods.description: Checks that no schema is specified when calling textFile.
